changeSet.author: sondos
changeSet.sql: CREATE OR REPLACE VIEW reports.vwencounterdischargelog AS SELECT edl.id, edl.encounter_id, edl.discharged_at, edl.discharged_by, edl.created_date, edl.discharge_type FROM public.encounter_discharge_log edl;

changeSet.author: sondos
changeSet.sql: GRANT USAGE ON SCHEMA reports TO report_user;
GRANT SELECT ON reports.vwencounterdischargelog TO report_user;

rollback.sql: REVOKE SELECT ON reports.vwencounterdischargelog FROM report_user;
